title.zh: 机器人学习项目协调员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Coordinate beginner robotics sessions, instructors’ timetables and learning-kit resources.
requirements.zh: 协调入门机器人活动、讲师时间表及学习套件资源。

requirements.en: Deliver group activities and follow the centre’s safeguarding escalation process.
requirements.zh: 开展团体活动，并遵守中心人员保护问题升级上报流程。

requirements.en: Report attendance and learner feedback with clear distinctions between attendance entries, distinct learners and survey responses.
requirements.zh: 报告出席情况及学习者反馈，并清楚区分出席人次、去重后的学习者人数及问卷答复数。

requirements.en: Preferred: deploy production autonomous robotics software in a commercial environment.
requirements.zh: 优先：在商业环境部署生产级自主机器人软件。
